titleEn: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Vancouver? Real Timelines for 2026
titleZh: 溫哥華浴室改造需要多長時間？2026 真實工期指南
contentEn:
The short answer: a basic bathroom refresh takes one to two weeks. A full custom renovation runs four to seven weeks. A luxury spa bathroom with curbless shower, heated floors, and custom millwork stretches to ten to sixteen weeks in Metro Vancouver. Every additional scope item — layout change, steam shower, permit queue — adds days to the schedule.

How Long Does Each Bathroom Renovation Phase Take?

Most bathroom projects break into five phases: planning, demo, rough-in, finishing, and final inspection. A simple fixture replacement (vanity, toilet, tub reglaze) keeps each phase short: demo is a day, rough-in runs two to five days, and finishing takes one to two weeks. A full gut renovation with waterproofing membrane, new tile, and custom fixtures runs four to seven weeks total. Luxury projects with steam showers and custom millwork extend to ten to sixteen weeks minimum.

Before signing a contract, ask for a written phase-by-phase schedule. Reno Stars includes this in every fixed-price proposal during the in-home consultation.

Does a Bathroom Renovation Need a Permit in Vancouver?

Not always — but the rules are specific. Replacing existing fixtures in place (toilet, vanity, tub) typically requires no permit. Moving plumbing fixtures — shifting the toilet location, relocating the shower drain — requires a permit under BC Plumbing Code. Electrical panel upgrades and new dedicated circuits also need one. Structural changes, including tub-to-shower conversions with framing modifications, always need a building permit. Reno Stars handles permit applications as part of every renovation contract that requires one. Permit timelines from the City of Vancouver run two to four weeks; Surrey and Burnaby are typically two to three weeks.

What Is the Realistic Timeline for Each Renovation Scope?

Cosmetic refresh (new vanity, toilet, lighting, paint): one to two weeks. Standard refresh (tub refinish or surround, new vanity, new toilet, tile flooring): three to four weeks. Full gut with custom tile shower and new plumbing fixtures: four to seven weeks. Premium ensuite with curbless shower, heated floors, and custom millwork: seven to ten weeks. Luxury spa bathroom with steam system, designer tile, and smart fixtures: ten to sixteen weeks minimum.

These timelines assume normal material lead times and no structural surprises. Asbestos in pre-1990 homes, knob-and-tube wiring, or low ceiling conditions that require structural work each add days or weeks. Reno Stars inspects all three before finalizing a schedule.

Why Does Professional Project Management Matter for Timeline?

Bathroom renovations in Vancouver involve multiple licensed trades — plumber, electrician, tile setter, waterproofing specialist, and finisher — working in sequence. Each trade waits for the previous one to finish and passes the site to the next. In a tight Metro Vancouver market, scheduling delays compound quickly: one week late from the plumber becomes two weeks late from the tiler, because tiler availability depends on finishing the plumber's work.

Reno Stars employs its own licensed tradespeople directly, controlling scheduling across all phases. Material lead times for specialty items — curbless shower hardware, custom vanity, heated floor mat — can stretch eight to twelve weeks in 2026. Reno Stars maintains relationships with Metro Vancouver suppliers to track availability and order long-lead items at contract signing.

Bathroom Renovation Timeline FAQ

How long does a complete bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A basic refresh (new vanity, toilet, lighting, paint) takes one to two weeks. A standard renovation with new tile, tub or shower, and updated plumbing runs three to four weeks. A full gut with custom tile shower, heated floors, and premium fixtures runs four to seven weeks. A luxury spa bathroom with steam shower and custom millwork extends to ten to sixteen weeks or longer. Every scope item that changes the layout or adds specialty systems pushes the end date further.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Vancouver?

You do not need a permit for cosmetic-only work: replacing a vanity, toilet, or tub in the same location, painting, and changing light fixtures. You do need a permit to move any plumbing fixture (toilet, shower, sink), upgrade an electrical panel, or alter any structural element. Reno Stars includes permit handling in every contract where one is required. City of Vancouver permit timelines run two to four weeks; Surrey and Burnaby are typically two to three weeks.

What drives the timeline longer than expected?

Scope additions are the most common cause of delays: adding heated floors after demo starts, upgrading from a standard tub to a curbless shower mid-project, or discovering knob-and-tube wiring that must be addressed before tiling. Each of these requires a scope amendment and new material lead time. Material delays for specialty items — curbless shower channel drains, custom vanity, heated floor mat — can run eight to twelve weeks in 2026. A licensed contractor surfaces these items during the pre-construction assessment, before the contract is signed.

contentZh:
簡短回答：基本浴室更新需要一至兩週。全訂製改造工程期為四至七週。配備無柵欄淋浴、暖地板和訂製櫃的豪華水療浴室在加拿大低陸平原需要十至十六週。每一個額外工程範圍——格局變動、蒸汽淋浴、許可排隊——都會延長整體工期。

每個浴室改造階段需要多長時間？

大多數浴室工程分為五個階段：規劃、拆除、粗裝修、細部裝修和最終驗收。簡單的固定裝置更換（洗手台、馬桶、浴缸）每個階段時間較短：拆除一天，粗裝修兩至五天，細部裝修一至兩週。全面拆除重建並採用防水膜、新瓷磚和訂製固定裝置的工程總工期為四至七週。配備蒸汽淋浴和訂製櫃的豪華工程至少需要十至十六週。

在簽訂合約之前，應要求提供書面分階段工期表。聚星裝修在每次上門諮詢中都會在固定價格方案中包含工期表。

溫哥華浴室改造需要許可證嗎？

並非總是需要——但規定很明確。在原位置更換固定裝置（馬桶、洗手台、浴缸）通常不需要許可證。移動管道固定裝置——移動馬桶位置、重新安置淋浴排水——需要根據卑詩省管道法規申請許可證。電錶升級和新專用電路也需要許可證。任何結構變動（包括框架改動的浴缸轉淋浴改造）則一定需要建築許可證。聚星裝修在每份需要許可證的改造合約中都包含許可證申請處理。大溫哥華各市許可證審批時間通常為兩至四週。

各種工程範圍的實際工期是多少？

美容翻新（新洗手台、馬桶、照明、油漆）：一至兩週。標準翻新（浴缸翻新或周邊、新洗手台、新馬桶瓷磚地板）：三至四週。全面拆除新建瓷磚淋浴和新管道固定裝置：四至七週。配備無柵欄淋浴、暖地板和訂製細工的優質套房：七至十週。配備蒸汽系統、設計師瓷磚和智能固定裝置的豪華水療浴室：至少十至十六週。

這些工期以正常材料交貨時間和無結構意外為假設。1990年前房屋中的石棉、罐頭和管線布线或需要結構工程的低天花板條件都會增加工期天數。聚星裝修在最終確定工期表之前會對所有這三項進行檢查。

專業項目管理為何對工期重要？

溫哥華的浴室改造涉及多種持牌行業——水管工、電工、瓷磚師傅、防水專家和整理師——按順序作業。每個行業都等待上一個行業完成，然後將工地交接給下一個行業。在競爭激烈的大溫哥華市場，排程延誤迅速累積：水管工延誤一週會導致瓷磚師傅延誤兩週，因為瓷磚師傅的可用性取決於水管工工作的完成時間。

聚星裝修直接僱用自己的持牌行業從業者，控制在所有階段的排程。特殊物品的材料的備貨時間——無柵欄淋浴硬件、訂製洗手台、暖地板墊——在2026年可能需要八至十二週。聚星裝修與大溫哥華供應商保持關係，以在合約簽署時追蹤可用性並訂購長備貨物品。

浴室改造工期常見問題

溫哥華全面浴室改造需要多長時間？

基本翻新（新洗手台、馬桶、照明、油漆）需要一至兩週。配備新瓷磚、浴缸或淋浴和更新管道的標準改造工程期為三至四週。全面拆除新建訂製瓷磚淋浴、暖地板和優質固定裝置的工程為四至七週。配備蒸汽淋浴和訂製細工的豪華水療浴室需要十至十六週或更長。每增加一項改變格局或添加特殊系統的工程範圍都會推遲完工日期。

溫哥華浴室改造需要許可證嗎？

美容性質的工程不需要許可證：在原位置更換洗手台、馬桶或浴缸，以及油漆和更換照明燈具。移動任何管道固定裝置（馬桶、淋浴、洗手池）、升級電錶或改變任何結構元素則需要許可證。聚星裝修在每份需要許可證的合約中都包含許可證處理。大溫哥華各市許可證審批時間通常為兩至四週。

什麼會讓工期比預期更長？

工程範圍的增加是最常見的延誤原因：在拆除開始後添加暖地板、將標準浴缸升級為無柵欄淋浴、或發現必須在瓷磚之前處理的罐頭和管線布线。每項都需要工程範圍修改和新的材料備貨時間。特殊物品的材料延誤——無柵欄淋浴排水槽、訂製洗手台、暖地板墊——在2026年可能需要八至十二週。持牌承包商會在合約簽署前的施工前評估中發現這些問題。
